Both stones are destroyable and since planning step 175 (WALL) a stone dies at the first wall it breaks,
so each wall takes one stone: rolling_stone_1048 the ledge's and rolling_stone_728 the other's. Five pairs, 10 shots, none failed.

1. The second stone breaks the ledge. Left 1 to 46 along the ledge to x 498.6. rolling_stone_1048 sits on platform_ent_1058 between the alcove's post (x 222) and block00_ent_1059 (x 282 to 346, top y 50): no ray from the ledge, the floor or the plank reaches it, only one from above the block's top.

the stone is the SECOND portal's): the stone goes through on 260, falls 70 units onto the ledge and breaks wall 1061 on tick 277 at 4.67 m/s (the gate is 1.5) and is destroyed with it. Right 266 to 354: he walks off the block, along the plank and block 1062's top (y 112) and off their right end at x 480 on tick ~343,
and lands on the floor on 358 at x 500.6 (crystal 1089 on 354).

4. The mirror. A tap at (10, 146) (tap 730; x 2 to 20 and y 120 to 168 win): the shot passes the broken wall's gap, reflect_agent_1082 turns it on 749 and the leg opens a portal at (69.9, 56.2) over the plat's left end, on 776. one on the player (tap 796 at (72, 236)): through on 798, he lands on the plat on 810 and walks right (804 to 844) into the door: won on tick 825.

UNLOCKS: none (10 portals, medal 2).
